# Source provenance

The FT-Transformer and feature extraction are adapted from the user-provided `肌电分类程序/2-FT-Transformer-v1.4-年龄二分类.py`. The unchanged original is stored here for audit, not imported at runtime. Its age labels, file splitting and training loop are not reused.

QMF/TMC formula reference: local QMF repository, RGBD-scene-recognition, https://github.com/QingyangZhang/QMF. Reference copies retain original notices. No upstream model weights or datasets are redistributed. See README for adaptation differences. Third-party reference code is excluded from package discovery and linting.
